Use case: stylized-concept. Create a beautiful production animation sheet for Hanni, based on the attached ORIGINAL high-resolution character reference. Preserve its exact appealing face, muzzle, brown eye shape, red-orange plush fur, cream cheek/tail tip, brown ear tips/paws, red-cream-gold Hanfu embroidery, sash and round 汉 pendant. Match the original's soft detailed fur, warm expression and tasteful polished 3D rendering. Avoid plastic fur, oversized bulging eyes, swollen round cheeks, flat lighting, cluttered silhouettes or awkward arms.
Overall canvas SQUARE, precisely THREE columns x TWO rows, SIX full-body DRAWN cels on TRUE transparency. Generous padding between characters, no backdrop/floor/shadows/grid/labels. This is one coherent six-frame animation with fixed camera, scale, lighting and pose foundation. Keep identical head silhouette/angle, torso, coat hem, feet and tail side in all six; the changing parts are the acting paw, eyes or page described below. Exactly TWO arms/paws, TWO feet, ONE tail. Props anatomically held by their assigned paw. Do not mirror, duplicate limbs or change hand roles. Each cel is a newly rendered pose, not a warped or rotated copy of one bitmap. Small readable incremental action, circular sequence with no abrupt frame6->frame1 reset. Frame6 is adjacent toframe1 in the motion. Same body placement, no whole-body bobbing/rotation/jumping. Where there is a book, make it neat, moderately sized, red with gold 'HanNi', not covering the muzzle or swallowing the costume.
E00 IDLE, REDESIGNED ELEGANT RELAXED POSE. Stand balanced, head only slightly tilted like the original, look warmly at viewer with a gentle CLOSED-mouth smile. Hold ONE CLOSED red HanNi book low against the upper waist, both paws naturally resting around its lower corners, elbows relaxed. Keep face, neck and gold collar clearly visible; no book shoved into chin, no crowded paws in center of text. Tail rests naturally behind canvas-left, one graceful silhouette. Six eye phases:1 open warm eyes looking forward;2 lids halfway closed;3 natural full blink (no change to cheeks/muzzle);4 lids halfway open;5 open eyes glance slightly toviewer-right;6 eyes return near center. Book/arms/body stay in same graceful pose. Calm, friendly, alert, never sleepy/smug.
